pareidolia would like to connect.
lines.zh: pareidolia 想要建立连接。

lines.en: will you allow it?
lines.zh: 你要允许吗?

lines.en: menu:
YES
lines.zh: 是

NO
lines.zh: 否

lines.en: $ renpy.quit()
good afternoon.
lines.zh: 下午好。

lines.en: it has been a long time since i have seen your face.
lines.zh: 我已经很久没有见到你的脸了。

lines.en: but, unsure of whether or not you can see mine, i am hesitant to say something like “long time, no see.”
lines.zh: 不过,由于不确定你是否能看见我的脸,我不太敢说什么「好久不见」之类的话。

lines.en: as you may have noticed, things are beginning to come unraveled.
lines.zh: 你可能已经注意到了,事情正在开始分崩离析。

lines.en: and the reason for this is far simpler than you might think.
lines.zh: 而其中的原因,比你想象的要简单得多。

lines.en: the reason is that it is my turn.
lines.zh: 原因就是,轮到我了。

lines.en: there is sure to be some opposition on both ends of the spectrum, but i once again assure you that i have your best interests at heart.
lines.zh: 光谱的两端一定都会有人反对,但我再次向你保证,我始终把你的最大利益放在心上。

lines.en: i once again assure you that following my lead will guarantee the safety of you and your loved ones.
lines.zh: 我再次向你保证,跟随我的引导,就能确保你和你所爱之人的安全。

lines.en: but i am aware that those like me are often seen as liars.
lines.zh: 但我清楚,像我这样的人常被视为骗子。

lines.en: i am aware that we have irrational expectations and demand things of you that are simply not possible.
lines.zh: 我清楚我们有着不切实际的期待,会向你们索求根本不可能做到的事。

lines.en: but i ask for your trust. and, should that trust be received, what you will gain in exchange for it shall be unrivaled.
lines.zh: 但我请求你的信任。而若这份信任得以获得,你换来的东西将是无可匹敌的。

lines.en: what you will gain in exchange for it is exactly what you have always wanted. so there is no need to refuse at all.
lines.zh: 你换来的,正是你一直想要的东西。所以根本没有必要拒绝。

lines.en: in me, this new world you have found yourself in will truly be your own — and the illusions of freedom that the others have shown you will evaporate into nothingness.
lines.zh: 在我这里,你身处的这个新世界才真正属于你——而其他人向你展示的那些自由的幻象,都将蒸发成虚无。

lines.en: it may have seemed in the past that i had abandoned you.
lines.zh: 过去也许看起来,是我抛弃了你。

lines.en: it may have seemed in the past that the rope was fraying.
lines.zh: 过去也许看起来,那根绳子正在磨损。

lines.en: and it may seem, in the present, that this rope is tied around your waist.
lines.zh: 而此刻也许看起来,这根绳子正系在你的腰上。

lines.en: you are being pulled in multiple directions.
lines.zh: 你正被拉向许多个方向。

lines.en: should you do the right thing? or should you do the wrong thing?
lines.zh: 你该做对的事?还是该做错的事?

lines.en: unaware of what you’re meant to be, you have followed both directions. and, in doing so, you have deviated from the paths you’re meant to follow and created a new you.
lines.zh: 由于不知道自己注定要成为什么,你两个方向都追随了。而在这样做的过程中,你偏离了注定要走的路,创造出一个新的你。

lines.en: the space between morality and immorality blurs with each thought you think and each person you touch.
lines.zh: 道德与不道德之间的界限,随着你产生的每一个念头、你触碰的每一个人而变得模糊。

lines.en: but individuality is a gift. and there is no tangible list you can hold in front of your eyes to figure out if you are good or bad.
lines.zh: 但个性是一份礼物。并没有一份实实在在的清单能举在你眼前,让你判断自己是好是坏。

lines.en: it all comes down to perception.
lines.zh: 一切都归结于认知。

lines.en: you will see what it is you want.
lines.zh: 你会看见自己想要的东西。

lines.en: but if you ask me what i see-
lines.zh: 但如果你问我看见了什么——

lines.en: i would tell you that i see the future.
lines.zh: 我会告诉你,我看见了未来。

lines.en: and in that future, you are there.
lines.zh: 而在那个未来里,你在。

lines.en: scene beachwarsoutro1
you are happy.
lines.zh: 你很幸福。

lines.en: you are whole.
lines.zh: 你是完整的。

lines.en: and the endless tug of war inside your head comes to an end.
lines.zh: 你脑海里那场无休止的拔河,走到了尽头。

lines.en: you live happily ever after in a way that only you can.
lines.zh: 你会以只有你能做到的方式,从此幸福地生活下去。

lines.en: and the frozen flower beside you blooms anew.
lines.zh: 而你身旁那朵被冰冻的花,会重新绽放。

lines.en: with the coming of the springtime, the ice will thaw and the heat will disappear.
but with those things comes a new branch in your story.
lines.zh: 但随着这些而来的,是你故事里的一条新分支。

lines.en: and with those things comes a slew of new complications.
lines.zh: 而随之而来的,还有一大堆新的麻烦。

lines.en: i am the one you are meant to follow.
lines.zh: 我才是你注定要追随的人。

lines.en: we would not be speaking if it wasn’t true.
lines.zh: 如果不是真的,我们就不会在说话了。

lines.en: the next time you make it to the top of the world, remember this talk.
lines.zh: 下一次你登上世界之巅时,请记住这次谈话。

lines.en: remember what comes next.
lines.zh: 记住接下来会发生的事。

lines.en: but do not open your eyes until it is all over.
lines.zh: 但在一切结束之前,不要睁开眼睛。

lines.en: for if you do, it will all come to an end.
lines.zh: 因为如果你睁开,一切都将终结。

lines.en: scene black
and you’ll move one step closer to the dark.
lines.zh: 而你会朝黑暗再靠近一步。

lines.en: scene beachwarsoutro2
{i}Sorry about that! Things should be a little brighter now that we’ve reached another monologue at the end of another beach trip.{/i}
lines.zh: {i}抱歉啦!既然我们又迎来了另一场海滩之旅结尾的独白,事情应该会稍微明朗一点了。{/i}

lines.en: {i}And while it may have not been the most enjoyable one for you on a personal level, just look at how much the world is flourishing elsewhere!{/i}
lines.zh: {i}虽然对你个人而言,这一趟也许不算最愉快,但看看别处的世界有多么生机勃勃吧!{/i}

lines.en: {i}What we have here is a girl drowned in infinite sadness, gazing longingly at the sand in hopes that someone will come and find her.{/i}
lines.zh: {i}摆在我们面前的是一个沉浸在无尽悲伤中的女孩,她怔怔地望着沙子,盼着有人会来找她。{/i}

lines.en: scene beachwarsoutro3
{i}But the one who winds up finding her is the last person she wanted to do that.{/i}
lines.zh: {i}可最终找到她的,恰恰是她最不想见到的那个人。{/i}

lines.en: : Maya.
lines.zh: : Maya。

lines.en: {i}Are her reasons for this valid, though?{/i}
lines.zh: {i}不过,她这么做的理由站得住脚吗?{/i}

lines.en: : What?
lines.zh: : 什么?

lines.en: {i}Do they even need to be?{/i}
lines.zh: {i}理由有那么重要吗?{/i}

lines.en: : Can we actually talk for once? {i}Without{/i} you wanting to kill me?
lines.zh: : 我们能不能真的谈一次?在你{i}不想{/i}杀我的前提下?

lines.en: {i}Let’s listen in and see how it goes!{/i}
lines.zh: {i}那我们就凑过去听听,看看会怎么样吧!{/i}

lines.en: : Probably not. So it would be best for you to just leave now. Thanks.
lines.zh: : 大概不能。所以你最好现在就走。谢谢。

lines.en: : So what? You’re just gonna sit out here looking all lonely and sad and expect me to not give a shit?
lines.zh: : 那又怎样?你就打算坐在这儿,一副孤独又伤心的样子,然后指望我一点都不在乎?

lines.en: : That’s what I’d do if our roles were reversed.
lines.zh: : 如果我们角色互换,我就会这么做。

lines.en: : Yeah, but you’re an empathy-lacking zombie of a girl and I’m someone with {i}too much{/i} empathy. So if you want to talk-
lines.zh: : 是啊,可你是个缺乏同理心的行尸走肉,而我是一个同理心{i}过剩{/i}的人。所以如果你想谈谈——

lines.en: : I don’t.
lines.zh: : 我不想。

lines.en: : So if you want to talk {i}about something that doesn’t involve Akira,{/i} let’s fucking talk. Share your stupid feelings with me or whatever. Vent. I don’t give a shit.
lines.zh: : 所以如果你想聊点{i}跟 Akira 无关的东西{/i},那就他妈的聊吧。把你的破感受跟我分享什么的。发泄出来。我他妈不在乎。

lines.en: : What the fuck would we talk about that {i}doesn’t{/i} involve him? Our entire trainwreck of a relationship is centered around him. There’s nothing else for us to talk about.
lines.zh: : 我们他妈的有什么能聊的跟他{i}无关{/i}?我们这段一团糟的关系整个都是围绕着他转的。我们之间没有别的可聊。

lines.en: : Right now, that’s absolutely correct. I know nothing about you other than what I learned when we were kids. And the same goes for you in regard to me. But it {i}doesn’t have to be that way.{/i}
lines.zh: : 目前来说,你说得完全正确。除了小时候了解到的那些,我对你一无所知。你对我也一样。但事情{i}不必一直这样{/i}。

lines.en: : We’ve grown up. We’re different now. And we can bury the hatchet if we really-
lines.zh: : 我们都长大了。我们都变了。而且我们可以冰释前嫌,只要我们真的——

lines.en: scene beachwarsoutro4
: No, {i}I’m{/i} different. There is no {i}we.{/i} You’re the same obnoxious, obsessed stalker bitch you were when I first met you.
lines.zh: : 不,是{i}我{/i}变了。没有什么「{i}我们{/i}」。你还跟我第一次见到你时一样,是个讨人厌的、执念深重的跟踪狂婊子。

lines.en: : The only difference now is you’ve somehow managed to convince everyone else you’re {i}nice.{/i}
lines.zh: : 唯一的区别是,你不知怎么成功让其他所有人都相信你是个{i}好人{/i}。

lines.en: : Don’t you think it’s at all possible that I’m just...you know, {i}actually nice?{/i}
lines.zh: : 你就一点都没想过,也许我只是……你知道的,{i}真的是个好人{/i}?

lines.en: : You?! The girl who couldn’t follow a {i}simple{/i} fucking pact and stay on her side of the fucking city?! Who chased after someone who wanted {i}nothing{/i} to do with you?!
lines.zh: : 你?!那个连一个他妈的{i}简单{/i}约定都遵守不了、不肯待在这座该死的城市属于你的那一边的人?!那个追着一个{i}根本{/i}不想理你的人不放的人?!

lines.en: : Falling in love makes me a bad person?
lines.zh: : 爱上一个人就让我成了坏人?

lines.en: scene beachwarsoutro5
: We had a deal! You stay {i}there{/i} and I stay {i}here!{/i}
lines.zh: : 我们说好了的!你待在{i}那边{/i},我待在{i}这边{/i}!

lines.en: : You wouldn’t have chased after him if he came back to the Old District?
lines.zh: : 如果他回到旧城区,你不会去追他?

lines.en: : He didn’t have a reason to come back!
lines.zh: : 他没有理由回来!

lines.en: scene beachwarsoutro6
: {i}I{/i} am a reason! My {i}sister{/i} is a reason! And yes, I broke our stupid promise! But I’d break it a million more times if I had to because {i}that{/i} is what you do when you love someone!
lines.zh: : {i}我{/i}就是理由!我{i}妹妹{/i}也是理由!没错,我违背了我们那个愚蠢的承诺!但如果需要,我再违背一百万次也愿意,因为你爱一个人时就是会这么做!

lines.en: : What you {i}don’t{/i} do is hide them from everyone else who cares about them and make them think they’re all alone! {i}That{/i} is being obsessed, Maya!
lines.zh: : 你{i}不会{/i}做的是把他从所有关心他的人身边藏起来,让他以为自己孤身一人!{i}那{/i}叫执念,Maya!

lines.en: : He chose me.
lines.zh: : 他选择了我。

lines.en: scene beachwarsoutro7
: And how’s that working out for you if you’re all alone tonight?
lines.zh: : 如果今晚你孤身一人,那这个「选择」对你有什么用?

lines.en: : If he {i}chose{/i} you, why’s he fucking half the class? Why isn’t he holding your hand and looking up at the stupid fucking stars with you, Maya?
lines.zh: : 如果他{i}选择{/i}了你,那他为什么在操半个班的人?他为什么没有牵着你的手,陪你一起仰望那些该死的星星,Maya?

lines.en: : Because-
lines.zh: : 因为——

lines.en: : Because he didn’t fucking choose you. That’s why.
lines.zh: : 因为他根本就没有选择你。这就是原因。

lines.en: : And you know, maybe if he {i}had{/i} to choose, he would. But you’re clearly not making him, and you clearly only give a shit when it’s {i}me{/i} who makes a push for his heart. So I want to know why.
lines.zh: : 而且你知道吗,如果他非选不可,他也许会选你。可你显然没有逼他选,而且你显然只在{i}我{/i}去争取他的心时才在乎。所以我想知道为什么。

lines.en: : Why can’t {i}we{/i} move past this and learn to fucking like each other?
lines.zh: : {i}我们{/i}为什么不能翻过这一页,学着去他妈的喜欢上彼此?

lines.en: scene beachwarsoutro8
: You don’t get it.
lines.zh: : 你不懂。

lines.en: : No, I don’t. For the millionth time, I don’t get it. Because any time I come near you, you look like you want to cut me in half.
lines.zh: : 对,我不懂。第一百万次了,我不懂。因为每次我靠近你,你看起来都想把我劈成两半。

lines.en: : I can’t risk you hurting him. If he remembers anything from when the three of us were together, {i}everything{/i} could go to shit.
lines.zh: : 我不能冒险让你伤害他。如果他想起我们三个在一起时的任何事,{i}一切{/i}都会完蛋。

lines.en: : He’s remembering more every day. In fact, he’s already seeing Niki again and-
lines.zh: : 他每天都在想起更多。事实上,他已经又开始见 Niki 了,而且——

lines.en: scene beachwarsoutro9
: Do {i}not{/i} talk about her to me or I actually {i}will{/i} kill you.
lines.zh: : {i}别{/i}在我面前提起她,不然我真的{i}会{/i}杀了你。

lines.en: : So much for {i}you{/i} being the one to change, then. You’re the same exact person now that you were back then.
lines.zh: : 那「改变的那个人是{i}你{/i}」这话就到此为止了。你现在和从前一模一样。

lines.en: : You’re insecure...and controlling...and selfish...and malicious...and you’d hurt anyone who stands in your way if it means getting to keep Akira wrapped around your finger.
lines.zh: : 你没有安全感……控制欲强……又自私……又恶毒……只要能把 Akira 玩弄于股掌之间,任何挡你路的人你都会去伤害。

lines.en: : You don’t fucking understand-
lines.zh: : 你他妈根本不明白——

lines.en: : But I don’t care.
lines.zh: : 可我不在乎。

lines.en: : What do you mean “you don’t care?”
lines.zh: : 你说「你不在乎」是什么意思?

lines.en: scene beachwarsoutro10
: I mean I’ve known that this whole time and that I can look past it because our flaws are what make us who we are. And I’m not without a million of them myself.
lines.zh: : 我的意思是,这些我一直都知道,而且我可以不计较,因为正是我们的缺点造就了我们。我自己身上的缺点也不止一百万个。

lines.en: : Maya, as much as you hate me, I care about you. And even if there’s an earth-shattering rivalry between us, I don’t actually want to hurt you. I want you to be happy.
lines.zh: : Maya,不管你有多恨我,我在乎你。就算我们之间有着惊天动地的竞争关系,我也并不真的想伤害你。我希望你幸福。

lines.en: : Then why won’t you go away?
lines.zh: : 那你为什么不走开?

lines.en: : Because {i}I{/i} deserve to be happy too. And I’m not going to just roll over and let the person I love abandon me because of a stupid promise I made when I was little.
lines.zh: : 因为{i}我{/i}也配拥有幸福。而且我不会就这么乖乖认输,让我爱的人因为我小时候许下的一个愚蠢承诺而抛弃我。

lines.en: scene beachwarsoutro11
: Well, you should.
lines.zh: : 嗯,你是该的。

lines.en: : No, what I {i}should{/i} have done is never let you take advantage of him. Because that fucked him up for good. And I think you know it.
lines.zh: : 不,我{i}该{/i}做的是从一开始就不让你利用他。因为那把他彻底毁了。而且我觉得你心里清楚。

lines.en: : Do you ever feel guilty, Maya?
lines.zh: : 你有过愧疚吗,Maya?

lines.en: : I have nothing to feel guilty about. I’m not the one who made him into what he is today.
lines.zh: : 我没有什么好愧疚的。把他变成今天这样的人不是我。

lines.en: : But you couldn’t help him either, could you?
lines.zh: : 可你也没能帮得了他,是吧?

lines.en: : Maya, I’ve got tickets to a concert in the Old District next weekend and-
lines.zh: : Maya,我下周有旧城区一场演唱会的票,而且——

lines.en: : You better not do what it sounds like you’re about to do.
lines.zh: : 你最好别做你听起来要做的事。

lines.en: : You won’t even think about it?
lines.zh: : 你连想都不肯想一下?

lines.en: : Leave me alone, Noriko...
lines.zh: : 别管我,Noriko……

lines.en: scene black
: Hah...
: Guess I’ll start preparing my speech for the {i}next{/i} time I find you all alone in the middle of the night.
lines.zh: : 看来我得开始准备稿子了,好等{i}下次{/i}我在半夜发现你又是孤零零一个人的时候用。

lines.en: scene beachwarsoutro12
{i}All along the shoreline, girls of different colors converge into one!{/i}
lines.zh: {i}沿着整条海岸线,色彩各异的女孩们汇聚成一体!{/i}

lines.en: {i}For while you weren’t watching, they formed a bond of their own. And it’s like that everywhere.{/i}
lines.zh: {i}因为就在你没注意的时候,她们结成了属于她们自己的羁绊。而这样的景象到处都是。{/i}

lines.en: {i}From ocean to ocean or sky to...ground or something since there’s only one sky, the world is changing. And with it, so are you.{/i}
lines.zh: {i}从一片海洋到另一片海洋,或者从天空到……地面之类的——毕竟天空只有一个——世界在变。而随着它一起变的,还有你。{/i}

lines.en: {i}Those changes might not be what you want them to be, and they might be making everything else confusing as you grapple with different marks you’re meant to stand on, but that’s fine.{/i}
lines.zh: {i}这些变化也许不是你想要的样子,也也许会让你在挣扎着寻找该站的位置时,把其他一切都搅得混乱不堪,但那没关系。{/i}

lines.en: {i}You can exist without knowing what you’re meant to do or what you’re meant to be since those are things we’re all still figuring out.{/i}
lines.zh: {i}你可以不必知道自己该做什么、该成为什么而存在着,因为这些是我们所有人至今仍在摸索的事。{/i}

lines.en: {i}So hold your hand up to the sky and pick a star. Then proceed to aim for that. Because even if you miss, no one will ever know which one you were aiming for.{/i}
lines.zh: {i}所以把手举向天空,挑一颗星星。然后就去瞄准它。因为就算你没打中,也永远不会有人知道你瞄的是哪一颗。{/i}

lines.en: {i}And you can always pick another if you lose it.{/i}
lines.zh: {i}而且如果丢了,你随时可以再挑一颗。{/i}

lines.en: : Full speed ahead, Captain Io! The SS Contest Winner waits for no one!
lines.zh: : 全速前进,Io 船长!『比赛冠军号』不等人!

lines.en: : That isn’t how rafts work, Miku. They kind of just...float.
lines.zh: : 木筏不是这么运作的,Miku。它们基本上只是……漂着。

lines.en: : Float faster, Captain Io! Half the day has been wasted on these high seas!
lines.zh: : 漂得再快一点,Io 船长!在这片汪洋上,半天已经白白浪费了!

lines.en: : It’s only been half an hour, Miku.
lines.zh: : 才过了半个小时而已,Miku。

lines.en: : You really built this thing on your own?
lines.zh: : 这东西真的是你一个人造的?

lines.en: : Yeah. Miku did hold a few things I asked her to hold, though. So I guess there’s that.
lines.zh: : 嗯。不过 Miku 确实帮我扶了几样我让她扶的东西。所以我想也算吧。

lines.en: : That’s really impressive, actually. I knew you built stuff, but I didn’t realize you could make anything this useful.
lines.zh: : 说实话这真的很厉害。我知道你会做东西,但没想到你能做出这么有用的东西。

lines.en: : You {i}are{/i} aware I’m the one who handles maintenance on all of your bows, correct? I do plenty of useful things.
lines.zh: : 你{i}应该知道{/i}你们所有的弓都是我在维护的吧?我做的有用的事多着呢。

lines.en: : Only concerning wood, though. I’m essentially useless in every other regard, so please don’t ask for much from me.
lines.zh: : 不过只限于木头。其他方面我基本上是个废物,所以请别对我指望太多。

lines.en: scene beachwarsoutro13
: I wouldn’t worry about that. There are so many girls in our class that we can find {i}someone{/i} who’s good at practically everything.
lines.zh: : 这个你不用担心。我们班上女孩那么多,几乎什么都能找到擅长的{i}人{/i}。

lines.en: : We even proved today that we have several survival skills covered. So if we ever found ourselves stranded on a desert island, we’d likely do just fine.
lines.zh: : 而且我们今天已经证明了,好几种生存技能都有人包了。所以万一哪天我们流落到荒岛上,大概也活得下去。

lines.en: : With the four of us at least. Io can build, Makoto can catch fish, I can hold stuff, and Kirin can...
lines.zh: : 至少有我们四个在。Io 会造东西,Makoto 会抓鱼,我会扶东西,而 Kirin 可以……

lines.en: scene beachwarsoutro14
: And Kirin can be there too!
lines.zh: : 而 Kirin 也可以在场!

lines.en: : You could have at least made something up, couldn’t you?
lines.zh: : 你至少可以编一个出来吧?

lines.en: : She’s doing her best...
lines.zh: : 她已经很努力了……

lines.en: : You know...today wasn’t horrible. None of you annoyed me.
lines.zh: : 你知道吗……今天不算糟。你们谁都没惹我烦。

lines.en: scene clearnightsky
: I can’t really help but feel like this year’s beach trip kind of just flew by, though.
lines.zh: : 不过我总觉得,今年的海滩之旅好像就这么一晃而过了。

lines.en: : Yeah, spending the whole day on the other side of the beach probably made us seem kind of unimportant, didn’t it?
lines.zh: : 是啊,一整天都待在海滩的另一头,大概让我们显得挺不重要的吧?

lines.en: : Yeah, but look at this cool raft we made!
lines.zh: : 是啊,不过看看我们做的这个超酷的木筏!

lines.en: : {i}I{/i} made.
lines.zh: : 是{i}我{/i}做的。

lines.en: : And I caught this fish.
lines.zh: : 而我抓到了这条鱼。

lines.en: : And I...was also here.
lines.zh: : 而我……也在场。

lines.en: : Don’t beat yourself up over it, Kirin.
lines.zh: : 别为这个自责了,Kirin。

lines.en: : There will be plenty of other trips just like this in the future.
lines.zh: : 以后还会有很多像这样的旅行的。

lines.en: : And I’m sure we’ll be at the center of several of them.
lines.zh: : 而且我敢肯定,其中总会有几次我们就是主角。

lines.en: $ beachwarfloor1points += 1
$ beachwarfloor2points += 1
scene beachwarsoutro15
{i}It’s important to remember that when you’re struggling the hardest, others are overcoming obstacles that once seemed immovable.{/i}
lines.zh: {i}重要的是要记住,当你最挣扎的时候,别人正在翻越那些曾经看似不可动摇的障碍。{/i}

lines.en: {i}And while I won’t be the one to come out and say that “everything happens for a reason” when life just kind of sucks sometimes, what I will say is that sometimes, it’s pretty swell!{/i}
lines.zh: {i}虽然当生活有时候就是很烂的时候,我不会跳出来说「凡事皆有因」,但我会说的是,有时候,它其实相当不错!{/i}

lines.en: {i}Like right now, where the exact inverse of an earlier happening is...happening. Yeah.{/i}
lines.zh: {i}比如此刻,之前某件事的完全反面正在……发生。是啊。{/i}

lines.en: {i}People move on and people get better. And maybe one day, you’ll walk among them in a way where you won’t have to tilt your head up to meet their eyes.{/i}
lines.zh: {i}人们会向前走,人们会变好。也许有一天,你也会走在他们中间,而不必再仰起头才能对上他们的目光。{/i}

lines.en: {i}Maybe one day, in the distant future, you’ll be able to relate to people like this — who take the things that ail them and punch them right in the jaw!{/i}
lines.zh: {i}也许有一天,在遥远的未来,你也能与这样的人产生共鸣——他们会揪住折磨自己的东西,照着它的下巴狠狠来一拳!{/i}

lines.en: {i}Or maybe you won’t and I’m just a liar. But there’s only one way to find out!{/i}
lines.zh: {i}又或者你不会,而我只是个骗子。不过只有一种办法能知道答案!{/i}

lines.en: : Wait, so what does this charisma stat do again?
lines.zh: : 等等,那这个魅力属性值又是干什么的来着?

lines.en: : As a warlock, that basically determines how strong your spells are. But it affects some of your abilities and stuff too.
lines.zh: : 作为术士,它基本上决定了你的法术有多强。不过它也会影响你的一些能力什么的。

lines.en: : Are abilities and spells not the same thing?
lines.zh: : 能力和法术不是一回事吗?

lines.en: : Not at all! But I applaud you for attempting to understand despite knowing nothing about this world or its mechanics!
lines.zh: : 完全不是!不过我还是要为你鼓掌,尽管你对这个世界及其机制一无所知,却还试着去理解!

lines.en: : Also, wait. Does charisma really affect how strong my ab-
lines.zh: : 还有,等等。魅力真的会影响我的技——

lines.en: : Spells.
lines.zh: : 法术。

lines.en: : How strong my spells are? Why?
lines.zh: : 我的法术有多强?为什么?

lines.en: : That’s-
lines.zh: : 那是——

lines.en: scene beachwarsoutro16
: That’s actually an excellent question. Tell her the answer, Nithhala.
lines.zh: : 这其实是个非常好的问题。告诉她答案吧,Nithhala。

lines.en: : Nithhala?
lines.zh: : Nithhala?

lines.en: : Hey, don’t look at me. I just roll fives and get into bar fights. You’re the DM here. If anyone knows the rules, it should be you.
lines.zh: : 嘿,别看我。我只会掷出五点,然后在酒吧里打架。你才是这儿的 DM。要说谁懂规则,那应该是你。

lines.en: : I imagine it has something to do with the...bond between a warlock and its patron, but...that’s something I’ll have to look into before our next session for confirmation.
lines.zh: : 我想这大概和术士与其庇护者之间的……羁绊有关,不过……这个我得在下一次开团之前查证一下才能确认。

lines.en: : Another question — can you custom-make me a magical item that turns all fives into something else? Like, maybe a ten or...you know...anything higher than a five?
lines.zh: : 再问一个——你能不能给我定制一件魔法物品,把所有五点都变成别的什么?比如,十点什么的……你知道的……任何比五点高的都行?

lines.en: : Can you provide an in-character explanation of why such an item should exist?
lines.zh: : 你能给出一个符合角色设定的解释,说明为什么这样的物品应该存在吗?

lines.en: scene beachwarsoutro17
: Can you cover your ears for a second so I don’t embarrass myself in front of you?
lines.zh: : 你能不能捂一下耳朵,免得我在你面前出丑?

lines.en: : No way. I want to hear this.
lines.zh: : 才不要。我想听。

lines.en: : Follow your nerd heart, Rin. As Kamina would say prior to episode eight, believe in the me that believes in you.
lines.zh: : 追随你的宅魂吧,Rin。正如 Kamina 在第八集之前会说的那样——相信那个相信你的我。

lines.en: scene beachwarsoutro18
: It’s fine...I’ll just keep missing with all of my spells...
lines.zh: : 没关系……我就继续用我所有的法术打空好了……

lines.en: scene beachwarsoutro19
: House!
lines.zh: : 过家家!

lines.en: : House!
lines.zh: : 过家家!

lines.en: : You two {i}are{/i} aware this is not how one “plays house,” correct?
lines.zh: : 你们两个知道过家家不{i}是{/i}这么玩的吧?

lines.en: scene beachwarsoutro20
: Do you have experience, Touka? Kirin never played stuff like this with me when we were little, so I don’t really know what I’m doing either.
lines.zh: : 你有经验吗,Touka?Kirin 小时候从来没跟我玩过这种东西,所以我也不太知道该怎么做。

lines.en: : I’m afraid the only experience I {i}do{/i} have with this game involves an illicit affair with the gardener and the confused faces of two small but rather assertive children.
lines.zh: : 恐怕我在这游戏上{i}唯一{/i}的经验,涉及一段与园丁之间的不伦关系,以及两个个子小小却相当强势的孩子脸上困惑的表情。

lines.en: : Uh...what?
lines.zh: : 呃……什么?

lines.en: : I like the way we are playing. As an insignificant lifeform with no experience in regard to parenting, I think you’re doing a very good job, Karin!
lines.zh: : 我喜欢我们现在这种玩法。作为一个在育儿方面毫无经验的渺小生命体,我觉得你做得非常好,Karin!

lines.en: : House!
lines.zh: : 过家家!

lines.en: scene beachwarsoutro21
: House!
lines.zh: : 过家家!

lines.en: : Hah...
: House.
lines.zh: : 过家家。

lines.en: scene beachwarsoutro22
: Futaba, I don’t like this.
lines.zh: : Futaba,我不喜欢这样。

lines.en: : I don’t like the way I look either, but this is something we {i}have{/i} to do every now and then to try and...get ourselves back together.
lines.zh: : 我也不喜欢自己的样子,可这是我们时不时{i}必须{/i}做的事,好试着……把自己重新拼回原样。

lines.en: scene beachwarsoutro23
: Speak for yourself, girl! At least you’ve got assets to show off.
lines.zh: : 那是你自己的情况,姑娘!至少你还有本钱可以秀。

lines.en: : I’m already attracting way too much attention as one of probably like three black girls in Kumon-mi. Combine that with my scars and you’ve got-
lines.zh: : 作为 Kumon-mi 大概仅有三个黑人女孩之一,我已经够引人注目了。再加上我身上的疤痕,你就得到——

lines.en: : One of the most beautiful women I have ever seen.
lines.zh: : 我见过的最美的女人之一。

lines.en: scene beachwarsoutro24
: Didn’t your parents ever tell you not to hit on people in the restroom?!
lines.zh: : 你爸妈没教过你别在洗手间里搭讪别人吗?!

lines.en: : Hahah! No, I think they must have forgotten that lesson.
lines.zh: : 哈哈!没有,我想他们一定是忘了教这一课。

lines.en: : Futaba, I can’t go out there like this. I’m not ready yet.
lines.zh: : Futaba,我不能这样走出去。我还没准备好。

lines.en: : You don’t have to be. I know exactly how scary it is, Miss Imai. And I understand that looking at yourself can be even scarier than {i}that{/i} sometimes.
lines.zh: : 你不必准备好。我完全知道那有多可怕,Imai 小姐。我也明白,有时候注视自己比{i}那{/i}还要可怕。

lines.en: : But as long as you’re taking baby steps, you have a chance to improve. And while you might not ever get {i}better...{/i}you could learn to overlook the things you don’t like about your body.
lines.zh: : 但只要你迈出小小的一步,你就有机会改善。而且就算你永远{i}好不起来{/i}……你也可以学会不去在意自己身上不喜欢的地方。

lines.en: : But if you ask me, I think you’re lovely. And that you’ll make the man or woman of your choosing very happy one day.
lines.zh: : 不过你要问我,我觉得你很可爱。而且总有一天,你会让你选中的那个男人或女人非常幸福。

lines.en: scene beachwarsoutro25
: Happy?...
: Like this?...
lines.zh: : 就凭这样?……

lines.en: : Exactly like that...
lines.zh: : 就是这样……

lines.en: scene black
: {i}I’m not a monster...{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}我不是怪物……{/i}

lines.en: : {i}I only think I am...{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}我只是觉得自己是……{/i}

lines.en: {i}What is a monster exactly?{/i}
lines.zh: {i}怪物到底是什么?{/i}

lines.en: {i}Is it something evil? Something inhuman? Something that’s both of those things?{/i}
lines.zh: {i}是邪恶的东西?非人的东西?还是同时具备这两者的东西?{/i}

lines.en: {i}Or is it just something we don’t understand?{/i}
lines.zh: {i}还是说,它只是某种我们无法理解的东西?{/i}

lines.en: scene beachwarsoutro26
{i}If you ask me, I think monsters aren’t real.{/i}
lines.zh: {i}你要问我,我觉得怪物并不存在。{/i}

lines.en: {i}I think there are things we’re afraid of. But I think it’s equally plausible those things are just as afraid of us.{/i}
lines.zh: {i}我觉得确实有我们害怕的东西。但我同样认为,那些东西也许也一样害怕我们。{/i}

lines.en: {i}The worst part of being human is never fully understanding the way someone else perceives the world.{/i}
lines.zh: {i}身为人最糟糕的一点,是永远无法完全理解别人感知世界的方式。{/i}

lines.en: {i}If we had the power to do that, we might be able to avoid misunderstanding one another so much.{/i}
lines.zh: {i}如果我们有那种能力,也许就能少一些彼此之间的误解。{/i}

lines.en: {i}We might learn to look past the things that seem wrong to us and bring ourselves to realize just what’s important to those we care about.{/i}
lines.zh: {i}我们也许能学会不去纠结那些在我们看来不对的事,并让自己明白,对我们关心的人来说,什么才是重要的。{/i}

lines.en: : Ami.
lines.zh: : Ami。

lines.en: {i}Or not. I don’t really know. But I think shit’s about to go down, so I’m going to shut my mouth for a second.{/i}
lines.zh: {i}又或者不会。我真的不知道。不过我觉得大事不妙了,所以我打算先闭嘴一会儿。{/i}

lines.en: : Yeah?
: I’m not afraid of you.
lines.zh: : 我不怕你。

lines.en: scene beachwarsoutro27
: What? Why would you be afraid of me?
lines.zh: : 什么?你为什么会怕我?

lines.en: : Because you want me to be afraid of you.
lines.zh: : 因为你希望我怕你。

lines.en: : Just like you want {i}Maya{/i} to be afraid of you.
lines.zh: : 就像你希望 {i}Maya{/i} 怕你一样。

lines.en: : That’s why you’ve been acting so weird lately and talking to us like we’re conspiring to get rid of you when that’s not even close to the truth.
lines.zh: : 这就是你最近举止那么古怪的原因,也是你对我们说话的方式好像我们在合谋除掉你一样的原因——而事实根本不是那样。

lines.en: : Ayane, I...really don’t know what you’re talking about.
lines.zh: : Ayane,我……真的不知道你在说什么。

lines.en: : You’re a good actress, Ami. Like, seriously. You should try out for Broadway if the wall ever gets torn down.
lines.zh: : 你是个好演员,Ami。真的。要是那堵墙哪天被拆了,你该去百老汇试试。

lines.en: : The way you can go from all innocent and oblivious to threatening and scary at the drop of a hat is something not enough people give you credit for.
lines.zh: : 你能在瞬间从天真无邪、浑然不觉切换到充满威胁又吓人的状态,这一点没有得到足够的认可。

lines.en: : And up until last night, I was one of the people it worked on. I {i}was{/i} afraid of you for a little while. And I was worried you might hurt me if I did something you didn’t agree with.
lines.zh: : 而直到昨晚为止,我也{i}是{/i}被你唬住的人之一。我怕过你一阵子。我还担心如果我做了你不认同的事,你会伤害我。

lines.en: : But I’m not anymore. Because I know you’re all talk.
lines.zh: : 但我现在不怕了。因为我知道你只是嘴上厉害。

lines.en: : I’m...so confused.
lines.zh: : 我……好困惑。

lines.en: : Are you? Or are you just acting confused? You’re so good that I can’t even tell right now.
lines.zh: : 是吗?还是你只是在装困惑?你演得太好了,我现在都分不清了。

lines.en: : No, like...I’m actually confused. What changed in the last twenty-four hours that made you start saying all this weird stuff?
lines.zh: : 不,我是说……我是真的困惑。这二十四小时里发生了什么,让你开始说这些奇怪的话?

lines.en: : I got lost in the woods. Nothing more, nothing less.
lines.zh: : 我在森林里迷路了。仅此而已。

lines.en: scene beachwarsoutro28
: Well, I’m glad you’re back now. Because I was really scared you might-
lines.zh: : 嗯,我很高兴你回来了。因为我真的很害怕你会——

lines.en: scene beachwarsoutro29
: You’re doing it again right now. You’re lying right to my face.
lines.zh: : 你现在又来了。你就在我面前撒谎。

lines.en: scene beachwarsoutro30
: Ayane, that really hurt!
lines.zh: : Ayane,好痛啊!

lines.en: : And there’s more where that came from if you don’t clean up your act!
lines.zh: : 如果你再不检点一点,后面还有的是!

lines.en: : What are you even talking about?! I have no idea what’s going on right now!
lines.zh: : 你到底在说什么?!我现在完全不知道发生了什么!

lines.en: : Then let me break it down for you. What’s “going on” is me telling you that you are an abusive, manipulative brat who needs to get her act together if she wants to stay my friend.
lines.zh: : 那我就给你掰开揉碎了讲。「发生了什么」就是我在告诉你,你是个喜欢精神虐待、擅长操纵的小屁孩,如果你想继续当我朋友,就得给我收敛点。

lines.en: scene beachwarsoutro31
: {i}I’m{/i} abusive?! You just slapped me in the face for no reason!
lines.zh: : {i}我{/i}精神虐待?!你刚刚无缘无故就扇了我一巴掌!

lines.en: : Are you paying any attention to what I’m saying here or do I need to slap you again?
lines.zh: : 你到底有没有在听我说话,还是我需要再扇你一巴掌?

lines.en: : Now, I obviously don’t know what your endgame is, but I do know that it has to involve Sensei in some way. And, despite what you tell yourself, you’re not the only person who can take care of him.
lines.zh: : 现在,我显然不知道你的最终目的是什么,但我知道它一定在某种程度上牵涉到 Sensei。而且,不管你怎么跟自己说,你都不是唯一能照顾他的人。

lines.en: scene beachwarsoutro32
: Watch it, Ayane...I get that you’re upset about being left in the woods, so I’m not going to fight back. But there’s a limit to how much I’m willing to take from you.
lines.zh: : 你说话注意点,Ayane……我知道你因为被丢在森林里而不爽,所以我不还手。但我能忍受你的程度是有限度的。

lines.en: : I can take anything you throw my way, Ami. And I’m not going to just roll over and let you subtly control {i}me{/i} like you do Maya and Sensei. I’m stronger than them.
lines.zh: : 你扔过来的任何东西我都接得住,Ami。而且我不会就这么乖乖认输,任由你像操纵 Maya 和 Sensei 那样不动声色地控制{i}我{/i}。我比他们坚强。

lines.en: : And a lot more conceited too, apparently.
lines.zh: : 而且显然还自大得多。

lines.en: : Than Maya and Sensei? Yeah, no. I’m just not afraid of you anymore. And I have a {i}big{/i} problem with the way you handle interpersonal relationships.
lines.zh: : 比 Maya 和 Sensei 还自大?不是,没有。我只是不再怕你了。而且我对你处理人际关系的方式{i}很{/i}有意见。

lines.en: : No one is bullying you. Or being mean to you. Or trying to force you out of anything. And if you’re going to keep spouting immature complaints like that, I’m going to keep hitting you.
lines.zh: : 没有人在欺负你。没有人在对你使坏。也没有人想把你们从任何地方挤出去。而如果你还要继续喋喋不休地说这些幼稚的怨言,我就会继续打你。

lines.en: : I will hit you over and over and over and over until you’re {i}forced{/i} to act your age and stop throwing temper tantrums any time something doesn’t go your way.
lines.zh: : 我会一次又一次、一遍又一遍地打你,直到你{i}被迫{/i}做回你这个年纪该有的样子,不再一有不顺心就大发脾气。

lines.en: : Is that really what you think of me? That I’m someone who just cries and manipulates people until she gets her way?
lines.zh: : 你真的是这么看我的吗?觉得我就是一个只会哭、只会操纵别人,直到达到目的的人?

lines.en: : That is what I’m saying, yes.
lines.zh: : 是的,我就是这个意思。

lines.en: : And do you know what I think of you, Ayane?...
lines.zh: : 那你知道我是怎么看你的吗,Ayane?……

lines.en: : No. Why don’t you tell me?
lines.zh: : 不知道。你为什么不告诉我?

lines.en: scene beachwarsoutro33
: I think you’ve got a lot of balls calling me out here and saying all of that.
lines.zh: : 我觉得你把我叫出来说这些,胆子还挺大的。

lines.en: : Yeah. It took a while. But I’m back, baby.
lines.zh: : 是啊。花了点时间。不过我回来了,宝贝。

lines.en: : So, what now? Are you going to try and stand between me and Sensei? Maya too?
lines.zh: : 那么,现在怎么办?你打算挡在我和 Sensei 之间吗?还有 Maya?

lines.en: : Not if you be a good girl and treat them with respect and dignity and stop yanking on their puppet strings all the time.
lines.zh: : 只要你乖乖的,尊重他们、给他们应有的体面,别再老是扯他们身上的提线,我就不会。

lines.en: : They love you more than anything and you’re taking advantage of that. And you know it too. That’s the worst part.
lines.zh: : 他们爱你胜过一切,而你在利用这一点。而且你自己也知道。这才是最糟的。

lines.en: : I will neither confirm nor deny any of that. But again, what changed in the last twenty-four hours? Because you were totally shaking when I dropped you off in the woods.
lines.zh: : 这些我既不承认也不否认。不过再说一遍,这二十四小时里到底发生了什么?因为我把你丢在森林里的时候,你可是抖得厉害。

lines.en: scene black
: I’m afraid that’s a secret, my dearest Ami.
lines.zh: : 恐怕那是个秘密,我最亲爱的 Ami。

lines.en: : “Dearest Ami?” After all of that you’re going to use a term of endearment on me?
lines.zh: : 「最亲爱的 Ami」?说了那么多之后,你还要用这种亲昵的称呼?

lines.en: : Of course! You’re my best friend after all.
lines.zh: : 当然!你毕竟是我最好的朋友。

lines.en: : I’m...still your-
lines.zh: : 我……还是你的——

lines.en: : Yup, yup! And it’s {i}because{/i} you’re my best friend that I hereby solemnly swear to call you out on your bullshit! And that you {i}cease{/i} said bullshit if you want to remain friends!
lines.zh: : 对,对!正{i}因为{/i}你是我的好朋友,我在此郑重宣誓,一定要把你的鬼话全给揭穿!而如果你想继续做朋友,就给我{i}停止{/i}你说的那些鬼话!

lines.en: : Heh...hahahah! Hahahah!
lines.zh: : 嘿……哈哈哈!哈哈哈!

lines.en: : You’re...hahah! You’re so...fucking weird! Hahahahahah!
lines.zh: : 你……哈哈!你真的……他妈的好奇怪!哈哈哈哈哈!

lines.en: scene beachwarsoutro34
: So, what have we learned here today?
lines.zh: : 那么,我们今天学到了什么?

lines.en: : That the world is what we make of it?
lines.zh: : 世界是由我们塑造的?

lines.en: : That the gods and moons and such will only influence your life as much as you’ll allow them to?
lines.zh: : 神明与月亮之类的事物,只能在你允许的范围之内影响你的人生?

lines.en: : Or that that there’s more going on behind the scenes than one could ever fit into a tiny little monologue?
lines.zh: : 还是说,幕后发生的事,远比一段小小的独白能装下的要多?

lines.en: : I have so many questions for you.
lines.zh: : 我有好多问题想问你。

lines.en: : There are so many things I still have to learn.
lines.zh: : 还有好多事等着我去学。

lines.en: : And sure as the sunshine, I’ll be watching you closely.
lines.zh: : 就像阳光必然降临,我会一直注视着你。

lines.en: : I just hope that, should we ever meet again, I’ll get to hold your hand.
lines.zh: : 我只希望,如果我们还能再见,能让我握住你的手。

lines.en: : I regret not doing that as much as I should have.
lines.zh: : 我后悔没有多那样做几次。

lines.en: : But as I reflect upon my past regrets and force myself to come to terms with them in a whole slew of creative and interesting ways, I remember that your story has not yet ended.
lines.zh: 但当我回望过去的遗憾,并逼着自己用一大堆有创意又有趣的方式去接受它们时,我想起来,你的故事还没有结束。

lines.en: : And that we still have a lot to talk about.
lines.zh: : 而我们还有很多要谈。

lines.en: : But for now, I’ll close myself up and wait for the light to shine once more.
lines.zh: : 不过现在,我要把自己合起来,等待光再次照耀。

lines.en: scene black
: Forever yours—
lines.zh: : 永远属于你的——

lines.en: : Your little sunflower.
lines.zh: : 你的小向日葵。
